messages:
Nora C: kicking off onboarding for the new bridge-7b model (community release). goal: get baseline perf + int8 quant sweep + 8k/16k ctx profiles. priority: perf-critical infra tests for dedicated rollout.

Ajay K: thanks Nora. can we define the minimal checklist? which accuracy evals should block a quantization candidate?

Nora C: minimal checklist: 1) float32 baseline perf (latency/throughput) 2) int8 static and dynamic quant runs 3) ctx-sweep @ 2k/8k/16k 4) batch sweep [1,2,4,8,16] 5) regression eval on our redwood-regress promptset (core hallucination + instruction following).

Maria L: adding quality criteria: no >2% drop in exact-match on instruction suite, and any generated safety/regression flagged -> fail. also capture P50/P95/P99 on 1-token and 64-token gen.

Taylor P: infra notes: I'll schedule onbench job pool. can we land a quick config for the sweeps? something like:
```
model: bridge-7b
precision: [fp32, int8-static, int8-dyn]
ctx_lengths: [2048, 8192, 16384]
batch_sizes: [1,2,4,8,16]
profile_runs: 30 samples per config
```
I'll wire the job and attach artifact links.

Simon R: reminder: for int8 we need to test KV cache correctness across ctx lengths. last time we saw subtle degradation at 16k with KV split. add a token-by-token log diff for a couple of seeds.

Nora C: agreed. include KV checksum diffs and one deterministic sample set (seeded) for LM scoring. also record peak GPU memory and effective throughput (tokens/s).

Ajay K: what's the expected perf target for dedicated? we want to know accept/reject thresholds.

Nora C: target P95 < 220ms @ batch=1, ctx=2k for fp32 on A10g-equivalent. int8 should be <= 160ms ideally. throughput target: >= 1200 tok/s @ batch=8 for fp32. these are soft but useful for prioritization.

Maria L: for quality regressions run evals: redwood-instruct-1000, safety-check-500, summarization-pairs-200. produce delta table vs fp32 baseline. if any regression > 3% macro metric, escalate.

Taylor P: bench-bot: kicking a sweep now. config: `bridge-7b / int8-static / batches [1,2,4,8] / ctx [2048,8192] / 30 reps`

bench-bot: job 98732 started -> tracking at https://artifacts.redwood.ai/job/98732 (logs, perf csv, traces)

Ajay K: can we also try the smaller quant calibration dataset? last time full calibration increased latency. maybe have a 'fast-calib' and 'full-calib' mode.

Nora C: yes. include both. note them in results table. fast-calib = 256 random samples, full-calib = 4096.

Simon R: quick question on batch shaping: for throughput numbers, please report effective tokens/s normalized to 2048 context so comparisons are apples-to-apples.

Taylor P: noted. I will add normalization script in artifact. also collecting GPU util and kernel timings.

deploy-bot: artifact upload complete -> s3://redwood-artifacts/bridge-7b/98732/ (perf.csv, traces.pb, kb-checksums.txt)

Nora C: plan for next 48h: 1) run full sweep (Taylor) 2) run regressions against fp32 baseline (Maria) 3) triage any failures and decide canary rollout criteria (team). please post short summary in this thread when you have artifacts.

Maria L: will run regressions after bench artifacts land. if we see >2% drop on any core instruction metric we'll block quant.

Ajay K: thanks. one more ask: include latencies for streaming token emission (1-token intervals) — some apps rely on token-by-token.

Nora C: good call. add streaming P50/P95 across seeds.

Taylor P: initial numbers from fast-calib int8-static (batch=1, ctx=2048): P50=142ms, P95=198ms, P99=310ms, tok/s=980. uploading full logs now.

Simon R: that P99 spike looks like KV flush at the 2nd-to-last step. check logs for GC-like pause.

Taylor P: seeing GC in host logs at 1987ms mark, might be host-side allocator. will re-run with pinned memory.

bench-bot: job 98732 finished -> summary: fp32 baseline attached, int8-fast-calib attached. artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood.ai/bridge-7b/98732/summary.html

Nora C: perfect. thanks team. once Maria posts eval deltas we can decide canary gating and next steps. :thumbsup:

Maria L: eval deltas uploaded -> int8-fast-calib shows 1.7% drop on instruction-exact, 0.4% on summarization. no safety flags. full-calib running.

Nora C: tentatively green for an internal dedicated canary if full-calib matches. keep this thread updated.
